semantic_authority: Project 03 — A PRASA Business, Brand & Administration
target_variant: European Portuguese appropriate to Cabo Verde
intent: Supplies the approved English and Portuguese values for the on-site chat-style panel opened by the floating WhatsApp launcher. The panel is local HTML/CSS/JS injected at runtime by prasa-launch.js (and by mindelo-essentials.js on Mindelo Essentials), so the static-page localizer never sees this copy; it reaches the runtime through the governed <script type="application/json" id="i18n-strings"> block, on the same mechanism the media-fallback runtime strings already use. Strictly additive: it introduces no change to any previously approved key, retranslates nothing, and alters no lifecycle, publication, currentness or media policy. It authorizes no prefilled-message behaviour and no change to the governed WhatsApp destination.
